as_told: When Patrick Stewart was cast as Captain Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation (1987), someone objected that baldness would surely be cured by the 24th century. Gene Roddenberry replied that in the 24th century nobody would care about baldness.
lesson: In a better future, people will not judge others by appearance such as baldness.
what_happened: The line is widely repeated, most often by Patrick Stewart in interviews, as something Roddenberry said to a reporter or a colleague. The earliest text I found is a 1996 Paramount magazine, 'Star Trek 30 Years', which reports the objection and says Roddenberry's 'attitude was' that it did not matter whether there was still baldness in the 24th century. That text paraphrases his attitude; it is not a quote published as Roddenberry's own words. I found no interview, letter or text published under Roddenberry's name that contains the remark.

lesson_verdict.why: The lesson is a prediction about future attitudes, and no study can test it. I did not look for evidence on attitudes to baldness because the session's web-search budget was used up.

search_steps: Read the English Wikipedia articles 'Jean-Luc Picard' and 'Patrick Stewart' as leads. The Stewart article says that in an interview with Michael Parkinson, Stewart thanked Roddenberry for replying 'In the 24th century, they wouldn't care' to a reporter. Its sources are a 2008 Mental Floss blog post and a video, both relayed accounts.
Open Library search-inside for "cured baldness" Roddenberry: no hits.

Open Library search-inside for Roddenberry baldness "24th century": 60 hits. The relevant ones are a 1991 book 'Trek: The Next Generation' (voyagecontinuest00vanh), which says (in later phrase searches) that baldness had been cured generations before the 24th century and the men of that time find the natural look appealing; this is an in-story explanation, not Roddenberry's remark; the 1996 Star Trek 30 Years magazine; and James Hatfield's 1996 biography 'Patrick Stewart', which relays the exchange.
Open Library phrase searches "Baldness will be cured" and "Whether there is still baldness": only the 1996 Star Trek 30 Years text has the passage.
